artworks.title: Berks County Almshouse, 1895
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Edgar William and Bernice Chrysler Garbisch
artworks.description: The image shows a bird's-eye view of a pastoral community with a central large building complex surrounded by lush greenery and small structures. The horizon is high, displaying rolling hills and a light-filled sky. The brushstrokes are detailed, highlighting symmetrical trees, fields, and buildings. The color palette includes greens, reds, browns, and soft blues, accented by white picket fences and an American flag. Horse-drawn carriages and small figures are visible, and smoke rises from a chimney in the distance. Vignettes around the border show additional buildings and scenes linked to the community.

artworks.title: Flax Scutching Bee
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Edgar William and Bernice Chrysler Garbisch
artworks.description: This painting depicts a rural scene with people gathered in front of log cabins. Hills, sparse trees, and a haystack are visible in the background under a partly cloudy sky. In the distance on the left, two people stand on a pile of logs, a small fire breaking out on the far left and putting gray smoke in the air. Closer to us on the left, a man stands by a machine made of several horizontal rods, appearing to feed long strands of fiber or grain into it. Gathered in a line across the rest of the painting is a crowd of men and women, appearing to hold long, flat objects and bundles of thin fiber. Some of the people talk while others seem to dance. The people all have pale skin, and the women wear colorful dresses with aprons and bonnets, while the men wear jackets, vests, and top hats.

artworks.title: The Exhumation
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Edgar William and Bernice Chrysler Garbisch

artworks.title: Mr. Day
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Edgar William and Bernice Chrysler Garbisch
artworks.description: The image shows a man from the waist up. He is facing slightly to the left but gazing directly at the viewer. He has fair skin, light-colored eyes, and short, wavy brown hair. His facial expression is composed and neutral. He is wearing a white collared shirt with a high, stiff black neckband, a creamy yellow waistcoat, and a dark formal jacket. In his right hand, he holds a paper titled "RELIGIOUS INTEL." The background is a deep plain brown color.

artworks.title: Mrs. Day
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Edgar William and Bernice Chrysler Garbisch
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of a woman. She is seated with her body turned slightly to her left, her right arm resting on a reddish-brown plush armchair. Her face is turned towards the viewer, with calm blue eyes, a faint smile, and clearly defined features. Her hair is styled in elaborate curls framing her face, and she wears a white, lace-edged bonnet with a wide ribbon tied beneath her chin. She is dressed in a dark dress with a high neckline and wide, puffed sleeves. The background is a plain, dark color.

artworks.title: Henry Teller
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Edgar William and Bernice Chrysler Garbisch
artworks.description: The image depicts the upper half of a seated man with fair complexion, blue eyes, light brown hair styled neatly, and a composed expression. He is dressed in a dark suit with a high-collared white shirt and a black cravat. The man's right arm rests on the chair's arm, while his left hand holds a quill pen. In the background, there is a stack of papers.

artworks.title: Jane Storm Teller
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Edgar William and Bernice Chrysler Garbisch
artworks.description: The image depicts a woman seated in a three-quarter view. She has light skin, delicate facial features with slightly arched eyebrows, and her hair is styled with prominent coils. She is holding a small red book, with her left hand resting against her face. She wears a dark gown with long sleeves, a lace collar, and lace cuffs. She also wears a black cap trimmed with lace and a ribbon in pink, blue, and yellow. The background is deep brown, and she is seated on a red velvet chair with gold studs along the edge.

artworks.title: Anna Maria Cumpston
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Edgar William and Bernice Chrysler Garbisch
artworks.description: This painting shows a young girl in a full-length portrait. She is standing with her body slightly angled to the left and her left arm resting on a stone pedestal. The girl has light skin, straight brown hair with bangs, dark eyes, and a calm expression on her face. She wears a light pink dress with puffed sleeves, a fitted bodice, and a full skirt with lace details. A pink sash is tied around her waist, and she wears red shoes. She holds a pink rose in her right hand. The background features a lush green garden with dense foliage and a partly cloudy blue sky. The stone pedestal beside her appears to have a vase holding roses.

artworks.title: Master Cleeves
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Edgar William and Bernice Chrysler Garbisch
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of a young child from the waist up, facing forward. The child has light skin, blue eyes, short brown hair, and wears a red outfit with gold and white patterns. They hold a small, colorful object and stand in front of dark curtains with decorative tassels, with a hint of greenery visible in the background.

artworks.title: Bowl of Fruit
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Edgar William and Bernice Chrysler Garbisch
artworks.description: The image shows a large blue and grey bowl filled with various fruits, including grapes, peaches, and a pineapple. The color palette consists of blues, greens, yellows, oranges, and browns. The bowl is placed on a surface with the fruits and foliage overflowing in all directions.

artworks.title: Elizabeth Denison
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Edgar William and Bernice Chrysler Garbisch
artworks.description: The image depicts a woman from the waist up, seated and facing forward. She has fair skin, distinct facial features, and elaborately-styled, powdered hair with flowers and black plumes. She wears a red gown with lace, a white lace collar, pearls, and a corsage. She holds a book and the background is a plain, warm brown color.

artworks.title: Woman in Red Arrowback Chair
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Edgar William and Bernice Chrysler Garbisch
artworks.description: The image shows an older woman depicted from the waist up, seated in an upright position. Her facial features include fair complexion, prominent cheekbones, and blue eyes, with dark hair mostly hidden under a white bonnet with a frilled edge. She wears a dark-colored dress with full sleeves and a white detachable collar tied at the front with a blue ribbon. The woman holds a small book with her left hand resting on the armrest of the chair and the right hand gripping the book. The background includes a plain brownish wall.

artworks.title: Abraham Clark and His Children
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Edgar William and Bernice Chrysler Garbisch
artworks.description: This painting features seven individuals in a group portrait outdoors. Some sit while others stand, facing us. On the right appears to be an adult man wearing a black top hat and a black suit with a white collar, holding a book on his lap. He faces the left, towards the other six people. Those people appear to be children of different ages. There are three older boys wearing black suits over white collared shirts, while there are two younger looking boys with ruffled collars on their back shirts. Seated on the lap of one of the older boys appears to be a baby wearing a white bonnet and a white dress. All of the people have pale skin and short brown hair. The setting is rustic, with a backdrop of dark green trees, a blue sky, and a flowing stream with dark gray rocks on the left.

artworks.title: Portrait of J. L.
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Edgar William and Bernice Chrysler Garbisch
artworks.description: The image depicts a side profile of a person with fair skin, high cheekbones, a prominent nose, a lace cap featuring a pink ribbon, a high-collared white garment with lace trim and a bow at the neck, a brown garment on the shoulder, and a round badge with the initials "JL." The background is a solid, muted gray color.

artworks.title: Husband
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Edgar William and Bernice Chrysler Garbisch
artworks.description: The image depicts the upper body of a person seated upright. Their face is turned towards the viewer, showing fair skin, rounded facial features, light-colored eyes, fine eyebrows, full lips, and brown, curly hair styled back. The person is wearing a dark jacket, waistcoat, white shirt, and a black cravat. The background is a plain, muted brown color.

artworks.title: Daughter
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Edgar William and Bernice Chrysler Garbisch
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of a person from the waist up. The individual is seated and facing forward. They have light skin, large eyes, and subtly colored cheeks, with hair neatly parted in the middle and braided, secured with a red ribbon. The person is wearing a blue garment with a white neckline and white accents on the sleeves. Around their neck is an orange beaded necklace. The background features an interior setting with a vertical wood texture, flanked by red and gold drapes adorned with tassels. To the left, there is a partial view of a musical instrument on a table.

artworks.title: Sophia Burpee Conant
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Edgar William and Bernice Chrysler Garbisch
artworks.description: The image depicts a woman's upper body. She is seated in a sideways position but facing forward towards the viewer. The woman has dark hair styled in an updo with ringlet curls framing her face. Her facial features include fair complexion with a slight blush on her cheeks and blue eyes. She wears a yellow dress with puffed sleeves, patterned white lace detailing on the bodice, and a high waistline. Around her neck is a black choker with a gold pendant, and she has delicate gold drop earrings. She wears a bracelet on her right wrist and holds an ornate white fan in her right hand. The background is a plain, muted blue, with a reddish-brown drapery with tassels framing the top and sides of the portrait.

artworks.title: Catharine Hendrickson
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Edgar William and Bernice Chrysler Garbisch

artworks.title: Maria
artworks.medium: watercolor, pen, and ink on silk
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Edgar William and Bernice Chrysler Garbisch
artworks.description: The image shows a seated woman leaning against a tree trunk. She is in a reclining pose with her head resting on one hand and her eyes closed or looking downward. She has delicate facial features and long curly hair tied with a headband. The woman wears a flowing white gown with visible folds and a hint of decoration. Beside her is a small dog. The background features lush trees, a blue sky, and a small carriage in the distance.

artworks.title: Sophia Mead
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Edgar William and Bernice Chrysler Garbisch
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of a woman seated in a chair. She is facing slightly to the left and looking directly at the viewer. She has fair skin, light-colored eyes, and dark brown hair styled under a lace-edged cap. She wears a black dress with a lace collar and holds a small book titled "Sacred Songs" in one hand. She also wears a bracelet on her wrist. She is seated in a chair with a red upholstered back and an armrest draped with embroidered blue and green fabric. The background is a plain, muted brown color.

artworks.title: Possibly Harlan Page
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Edgar William and Bernice Chrysler Garbisch
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of a man's upper body. The man has a serious expression and wide eyes, with short dark hair styled in an upward manner. He is dressed in a dark coat and a high collared white shirt with a decorative front. The background is a solid dark teal color.

artworks.title: The Sargent Family
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Edgar William and Bernice Chrysler Garbisch
artworks.description: A man, woman, four children, and a black and white dog stand and sit in a row in a wallpapered room with a checkerboard patterned floor in this horizontal painting. The woman and children have pale, peach skin and the man has a ruddier complexion. The man stands to our left wearing a tall, black, brimmed hat, a black coat, a high-necked white shirt or kerchief at the neck, and knee-length breeches over white stockings. His pointed shoes and breeches have silver and gold buckles. He stands with his body angled to our right but he turns to look at us. He tucks his right hand, closer to us, into the opening of his jacket and he clasps the hand of a young girl with his other. This young girl and the three other children all have blond hair and green eyes, and all wear white, scooped-neck garments. The girl holding the man’s hand turns to look up at him, and she touches his coat with her other hand. To our right, another child swings a ball at the end of a long string for the small dog who leaps up for it. Near the right edge of the painting, a woman sits in a high-backed, upholstered chair with a baby on her lap and a toddler leaning on her legs. The fabric of the chair is patterned with brown and white stripes, with a vine pattern on the white stripes. The woman’s body is angled to our left, and she looks in that direction, almost in profile. She wears a ruffled white bonnet, a long black dress with white at the neck and elbow-length cuffs, and a strand of gold-colored beads. She has brown eyes and rosy cheeks, and her pink lips are closed. The baby sitting in the woman’s lap reaches for the ear of the toddler leaning on the far side of the chair, elbows propped on the woman’s legs. A door behind the man is ajar, leading into another room with a diamond-patterned floor. The wall running behind the group has brown paneling along the bottom half and the top half is patterned with pine-green diamonds on a seafoam-green background. Two wooden chairs with upholstered seats sit against the wall behind the children. Above the chairs, a window opens onto a landscape with a tree, fence, and hills painted in peanut brown and beige. A rust-red curtain has been pulled up and to the sides of the window, which is flanked by two bird cages, each holding one butterscotch-yellow bird. The floor is made up of a checkerboard pattern of harvest yellow and brown squares that have been painted with wavy lines to suggest texture or pattern. The perspective of the room is flattened, and the proportions of some of the people are a little off, especially the man, whose head seems too large for his body. The poses of the people are also stiff, though some of them are connected by gestures.

artworks.title: Possibly William Sheldon
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Edgar William and Bernice Chrysler Garbisch
artworks.description: In the image, a man is seated in a wooden chair, facing forward. He has light skin, blue eyes, dark brown curly hair, and wears a high-collared coat over a striped cravat. There is a white cloth around his neck, and he holds a thin object in one hand while a hat rests on his lap. A wooden bookshelf with several books is in the background.

artworks.title: Possibly Mrs. William Sheldon
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Edgar William and Bernice Chrysler Garbisch
artworks.description: The image depicts a woman seated in a wooden chair, facing slightly to the right. She has light eyes, a straight nose, and a set expression. Her hair is dark brown, styled in soft curls under a white bonnet with red and white striped ribbons and lace trim. She wears a light green gown with a lace collar, two gold necklaces with a heart-shaped pendant, and holds a black object resembling an ear trumpet. The background is a dark brown with red undertones.
